# Reproduce the published evidence

## Audited runtime

- R 4.5.1
- SCOP 0.8.9
- Seurat 5.5.0
- seed `20260807`
- 314 SCOP namespace exports

The package versions and optional-backend status are recorded in [runtime.json](evidence/real-data/runtime.json); complete session output is in [session-info.txt](evidence/real-data/session-info.txt).

## Rebuild

From the repository root:

```bash
mkdir -p artifacts/real-data/input
curl -L --fail \
  -o artifacts/real-data/input/pbmc_1k_v3_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 \
  https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-exp/3.0.0/pbmc_1k_v3/pbmc_1k_v3_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5

Rscript scripts/build-real-evidence.R
quarto render
```

The expected H5 SHA-256 is:

```text
8191f576550c1b449d03441b9eb098ee9f73fa82513d171ba87d31d551e3ffda
```

## Evidence chain

The [top-level manifest](evidence/real-data/manifest.json) hashes seven component manifests and every published real-data figure. It asserts:

- exact H5 → three-file and H5 → RDS round-trip checks;
- more than 900 cells retained in the single-sample workflow;
- a real Harmony reduction in the cross-source workflow;
- a non-empty pseudobulk result;
- at least 20 Moran-ranked spatial features;
- no synthetic primary evidence.

Large RDS checkpoints are regenerated locally under `artifacts/` and intentionally excluded from Git. Their SHA-256 hashes and byte sizes are recorded in component manifests.

## What is deterministic and what is external

The R seed fixes stochastic steps used here. Exact floating-point or UMAP coordinates can still vary with platform and dependency versions. CellTypist additionally depends on the Python environment and `Immune_All_Low.pkl`; the evidence manifest records the executed model and result summary.

## Synthetic legacy examples

The former synthetic cases are retained only as code-level smoke tests in the repository. They are not used as the curriculum’s biological evidence.
